title: A reliability test for its efficacy in Smartphone application for Computing joint range of motion: A Research Protocol
protocol: Explain the study procedure and purpose to each participant before commencing the investigation.
Ask participants to sign formal consent for participation in the study.
Recruit a total of 100 subjects (N=100) between the age of 20 to 60 years using simple random sampling technique.
Choose the left knee of all subjects for determining range of motion (ROM).
Measure knee flexion movement three times with two methods by each physiotherapist for 100 subjects.
Use Universal Goniometer as a clinical standard technique.
Ensure that the 3 physiotherapists are unaware of readings taken by other therapists.
